text: License Compliance Analyzer writes empty component/conflict/gap arrays and null productLicense when no LICENSE*, NOTICE*, vendor/, or third_party/ files exist, then commits and exits cleanly without error

License Compliance Analyzer notes LGPL-2.1 (paramiko) as a weak-copyleft advisory in license-summary.md when the dependency appears in requirements.txt but is not vendored — dynamic pip installation does not trigger LGPL obligations, but vendoring would

License Compliance Analyzer records UNKNOWN as spdxId for all manifest-declared (go.mod, requirements.txt) dependencies when trivy --license-full returns no license names — trivy does not resolve license information for unvendored packages with no local source, and fabricating identifiers is forbidden by the quality bar
